recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1960s-style album cover featuring a group of dancers in a wooded outdoor setting, overlaid with a dense arrangement of colorful, angled text banners and a heavy, stylized typographic header.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black header block against a naturalistic photographic background
Dynamic scatter of rectangular text labels creating a sense of movement
Juxtaposition of playful, hand-drawn display type with rigid sans-serif labels
Interaction between the dancers' poses and the floating text elements
coreInvariants: A solid black upper third for primary display text
A desaturated, slightly grainy outdoor photograph in the lower two-thirds
Multiple colorful rectangular banners angled at roughly 15-30 degrees

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of 6-7 dancers occupies the center ground, scaled to fill the width of the photographic section.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, pale yellow display text in the top right quadrant acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top left, follows the large header to the right, then zig-zags down through the scattered colorful banners following the dancers' limbs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with text and figures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (header background) and Pale Yellow (primary display text).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Forest greens and earthy browns in the background photo.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: A palette of 1960s 'mod' colors: coral, teal, sky blue, and salmon for the floating banners.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements contrasting with the muted, vintage-processed photographic values.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or digital-first colors; stick to offset-ink equivalents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, condensed sans-serif and slab-serif hybrids.
letterConstructionRules: Top-left text: Playful, irregular widths with rounded terminals and tight kerning.
Top-right text: Tall, condensed, high-contrast slab serif with sharp, heavy serifs.
Banners: Clean, bold sans-serif with uniform stroke weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated, heavy horizontal bars on 'E' and 'F'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, illustrative display type paired with functional, clean sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rope or wire element in the photo

preserve: The condensed nature of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the condensed, heavy weight of the main display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1960s-style photograph of a group of young people in mod fashion dancing in a sun-dappled forest clearing. The photo should have a slightly faded, grainy texture with a solid black rectangular bar covering the top 30% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, condensed, pale yellow slab-serif text in the black bar. Scatter multiple colorful rectangular banners (teal, coral, blue) across the photo area, each containing white bold sans-serif text angled at 20 degrees.

verificationChecks: Is the top section a solid black block?
Are the colorful banners angled rather than horizontal?
Is the main title text condensed and heavy?
Does the photo have a 1960s film aesthetic?

adjustableVariables: Amount of film grain in the photograph

avoid: Modern sans-serifs like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is perfectly horizontal in the lower section.
Verify the black header is a clean, solid geometric shape.
Check that the dancers' clothing reflects 1960s mod styles.
Confirm the color palette avoids modern neon hues.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a solid black header with condensed heavy type and a vintage outdoor photo scattered with colorful, angled text banners.
